definition: Strava's score for how hard a session was, based on the time spent in each heart-rate zone. The higher it is, the harder my heart worked.
A thumbs-up from someone on Strava, the same idea as a like.
Personal record: my best time on a segment or over a set distance.
A badge Strava gives on a segment, for a top-10 time or a personal best.
All the metres climbed in an activity, added up over every uphill stretch.
The time I was actually moving, with the pauses taken out. Elapsed time includes the stops.
Five bands from easy (Z1) to all-out (Z5), based on maximum heart rate.
Running speed bands in minutes per kilometre, from easy to fastest.
An indoor session, like a treadmill run, as marked by Strava. These have no GPS.
The same as Relative Effort, shown as one number per activity.
